items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: That's the first band left there, you know. That went anywhere. Eddie Vincent, Big Eye Louie. Jimmy Fall Out. And Bro... Freddie Kepard, Big Eye Louie, Eddie Vincent, Jimmy Fall Out.

ctx.x: Did they make much of a hit, that Creole band?

I should say they did. That's the first band left there, you know. That went anywhere. Eddie Vincent, Big Eye Louie. Jimmy Fall Out. And Bro, I think Bro was the name. Not this young Bro that started out with us.
Wellman Bro, you mean then, huh? Yeah. Wait, with Duke Ellington, is that the same?

items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: And Eddie Vincent was practicing every day with us.

ctx.x: McNeil, bro. He's here and Wellman, bro, is the old one. That's the one.
It must have been him. The old bro. Because he's right in age with Pauli and Vincent.
What was Pauli playing in that time?
